title: Tasty Heal
description: Add some food-items to heal yourself. It can help the "hardcore-beginner" players.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2036670f893d4c62f231c701a01eecb2de55c060.png)


## Overview

Tasty Heal adds new vanilla-style recipes that give players more ways to recover health through food.

The mod is designed to make survival and hardcore worlds a little more forgiving, without breaking the vanilla balance.

## Current items

- **Glistering Beetroot Soup**  

![glistering_beetroot_soup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83ebe9eaf3eaf35e08265ceb2cf3cbe7c5276ab0.png)
  
- **Super Sweet Apple**  

![super_sweet_apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4449717b555b97f17f8a2a2008b23558fe173c3.png)

- **Blast From The Past**

![notched_apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/059547c6d186a9c913e0b217215bcf70d292104f.png)
  

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## Compatibility

This mod is required on both client and server.
